mechanism: Isotretinoin is highly teratogenic and medroxyprogesterone may have reduced efficacy as a contraceptive when combined with isotretinoin, increasing pregnancy risk and fetal exposure to a potent teratogen.
action: Medroxyprogesterone monotherapy is insufficient contraception during isotretinoin therapy; patients must use two forms of contraception and have negative pregnancy tests, with isotretinoin requiring enrollment in iPLEDGE program.
